name: MedSci Skills
role: Medical literature search; topic scouting; design prompts; reference and reporting checks
license_or_terms: MIT project code; bundled checklists and citation styles retain separate terms
cost_and_access: Free source; agent hosting and selected databases or APIs can cost money
portability_and_dependencies: Compatible skill host; helpers vary from Python standard library to shell plus R/Python/document packages; local install has BuilderBob paths and launchers and Claude-specific service references
open_inputs_outputs: Markdown; BibTeX; TSV/CSV; JSON; scripts; workflow-specific figures
version_reference: v6.3.0 e0ea3b0be3bf529aa0b94ee5fd8450e78848932c plus local Codex adaptation
assessment_scope_and_limits: Nine named SKILL.md files and selected script/import and provenance records inspected; medical assumptions and ranking heuristics need method review; no workflow or service qualification

name: Computable Systems Engineering
kind: Agent skill bundle and local scientific helpers
role: System concepts; measures; evidence plans; bounded queue and failure models
license_or_terms: MIT project code; separately downloaded SysML parser and other dependencies retain their licenses
cost_and_access: Free source; local executor required; agent hosting optional and separately funded
portability_and_dependencies: Complete runtime needed; basic helpers use Python; native SysML route documents Linux Python 3.10+ Java/javac 21+ pinned parser and writable cache; native Windows unsupported
open_inputs_outputs: Text SysML v2; JSON; SVG; editable diagram sources; Markdown
assessment_scope_and_limits: Manifest and selected skills/docs inspected; README version label is alpha.6; computations only address authored model scope and do not validate real systems

name: K-Dense Scientific Agent Skills
role: Broader hypothesis framing and literature-review workflows; select domain-specific helpers separately
license_or_terms: MIT bundle; invoked packages and services retain their own terms
cost_and_access: Free source; selected AI APIs databases and compute may require payment
portability_and_dependencies: Agent Skills host; hypothesis helpers document Python 3.11+ standard library and local execution; review helpers document Python/requests and network; optional document and image steps add dependencies
open_inputs_outputs: Markdown; JSON; CSV; source/evidence ledgers; scripts
assessment_scope_and_limits: README license and two SKILL.md files reviewed; not a bundle-wide audit; hypotheses and empty searches cannot establish findings or novelty

name: OpenAlex
role: Cross-disciplinary topic and source discovery; citation links
license_or_terms: CC0 metadata; linked works and full text have separate rights
cost_and_access: Free basic tier; free key raises budget; heavier use can be paid; verify current limits before a large search
portability_and_dependencies: HTTP/JSON from any suitable client; account/key for applicable usage; record query syntax corpus filters paging date and cutoff
open_inputs_outputs: JSON records; CSV/TSV ledgers derived with provenance
version_reference: Live API documentation reviewed; record retrieval date and response snapshot per project
assessment_scope_and_limits: Discovery and metadata coverage are bounded; ranked results and citation counts do not prove novelty or quality; no completeness or API smoke test

name: Crossref REST API
role: Resolve registered DOI metadata; compare titles authors and updates; assist discovery
license_or_terms: Most metadata has no copyright restriction; some abstracts retain publisher or author copyright
cost_and_access: Public API is free without sign-up; paid Metadata Plus is optional
portability_and_dependencies: HTTP/JSON; identify the client and follow current rate/concurrency limits; DOI registration agencies and deposited metadata vary
open_inputs_outputs: JSON; citation records and CSV/TSV comparison logs
version_reference: Live REST documentation reviewed; record exact lookup and retrieval date per project
assessment_scope_and_limits: A registered DOI verifies identity only within available metadata; it does not verify claim support or quality; do not infer fabrication from a failed lookup

name: PubMed and NCBI E-utilities
kind: Public biomedical search and metadata service
role: Biomedical source discovery and PMID checks
license_or_terms: NCBI usage terms; abstracts and linked full text can retain third-party rights
cost_and_access: Free search; optional NCBI API key for higher request rates
portability_and_dependencies: Web or HTTP client; published limit 3 requests/second without key and 10 with key; aggregate shared-client traffic; biomedical coverage
open_inputs_outputs: PMID lists; XML/JSON; bibliographic exports; dated search logs
version_reference: Live usage documentation reviewed; record database query and date per project
assessment_scope_and_limits: Useful for biomedical topics; insufficient as the sole discovery source for broad OSRI work; source support and full-text access need separate checks

name: Zotero
role: Collect annotate deduplicate and share source records
license_or_terms: AGPL-3.0 unless otherwise indicated; attached source materials retain their own rights
cost_and_access: Free local application and metadata syncing; optional paid attachment storage; no agent subscription required
portability_and_dependencies: Desktop application on supported operating systems; account only for online collaboration/sync; third-party extensions such as Better BibTeX or MCP are separate
open_inputs_outputs: BibTeX; RIS; CSL JSON; Zotero RDF; notes; preserve native backup separately
version_reference: Documentation reviewed; choose and record application/extension versions per project
assessment_scope_and_limits: Exports do not preserve every library relation and are not backups; inspect required fields and attribution after exchange; no connected Zotero service tested

name: ASReview LAB
role: Human labeling with active-learning ordering for a documented review corpus
license_or_terms: Apache-2.0; input corpora retain their rights
cost_and_access: Free local software; local computing cost; no paid agent required
portability_and_dependencies: Python 3.10+; NumPy pandas scikit-learn Flask and other declared packages; browser UI; Windows/macOS/Linux setup documented
open_inputs_outputs: CSV/TSV/RIS exports; labeling decisions; .asreview archive with dataset history and model configuration
version_reference: Stable docs identify 3.0.8; pin software model configuration and seed per project
assessment_scope_and_limits: Model ordering does not establish full recall or justify stopping; predefine screening/stopping method retain unseen records and preserve independent reviewer decisions where required

name: R or Python with Jupyter
role: Reproducible analysis and executable notebooks; choose the language that fits the method
license_or_terms: R GNU GPL; Python PSF-2.0 with incorporated components under other licenses; Jupyter modified BSD; packages have separate licenses
cost_and_access: Free local software; compute and optional hosted services may cost money; no paid agent required
portability_and_dependencies: Supported local operating system; appropriate R/Python runtime kernel and method-specific packages; lock dependencies and relevant native libraries
open_inputs_outputs: Source scripts; .ipynb JSON; CSV/TSV; domain data formats; figures; environment lock files
version_reference: No project runtime selected; pin runtime packages kernel and relevant system libraries
assessment_scope_and_limits: Programming languages do not choose or validate the scientific method; notebooks need ordered execution and explicit inputs; no numerical package or result tested here

name: Quarto
role: Render editable writing and code into reports articles blogs books or slides
license_or_terms: Current Quarto MIT; bundled components and templates retain separate licenses
cost_and_access: Free local software; optional hosting services have separate terms; no paid agent required
portability_and_dependencies: Windows/macOS/Linux; bundled publishing dependencies; R/knitr or Python/Jupyter only for corresponding executable content; PDF engine depends on output route
open_inputs_outputs: Markdown/.qmd; .ipynb; BibTeX/CSL JSON; HTML; PDF; DOCX; source figures
version_reference: Documentation reviewed; pin CLI engines templates and citation styles per project
assessment_scope_and_limits: Rendering establishes document production only; citations figures computations accessibility and source fidelity still need checks; no render tested

name: Scite MCP
role: Optional source discovery and citation-context inspection inside a compatible agent
license_or_terms: Commercial service terms; implementation license not assessed; source content has separate rights
cost_and_access: Paid plan or active trial required for MCP; usage credits apply; Scite account and compatible agent required
portability_and_dependencies: MCP-compatible host and authenticated external service; disclose submitted queries/data and verify available operations before use
open_inputs_outputs: Retain permitted source identifiers excerpts citation decisions and a tool-neutral evidence ledger; do not depend on connector-only state
version_reference: Current MCP and pricing pages reviewed; record service date and exposed tool/model versions
assessment_status: plugin-directory discovered; document-reviewed; not installed or executed
assessment_scope_and_limits: Available but not installed for the inspected account; account access permissions behavior coverage and exports untested; citation classifications do not replace reading the source
